title: VoCo: A Simple-yet-Effective Volume Contrastive Learning Framework for 3D Medical Image Analysis
caption: Figure 1. (a) In 3D medical images, the contextual positions, i.e., the geometric relations between different organs are relatively con- sistent. (b) Aiming to leverage contextual position priors for pre- training, we proposed a Volume Contrast (VoCo) framework for 3D Medical Image Analysis.
